name: Tainted Keg
summary: At Tarren Mill, Tainted Keg carries a deadly brew made by Apothecary Lydon. Stolen dwarven stout bears the poison, bound for imprisoned human farmers as a test of the Royal Apothecary Society’s work.

sections.title: A Deadly Vintage
sections.body: Dun Garok's dwarven riflemen lost a barrel of Shindigger Stout to thieves. Apothecary Lydon mixed it with his newly refined Elixir of Agony. The Forsaken chose an ordinary drink to carry the poison, hoping no one would suspect it. A familiar ale became a swift death sentence.

sections.title: Testing on the Condemned
sections.body: Several human farmers were held upstairs in the Tarren Mill inn. High Executor Darthalia suspected a Stormwind military strategist was hiding among them. When word came that the strategist had died elsewhere, the farmers were no longer of use. Darthalia gave them to Lydon, who set the poisoned keg on the rug in their room as part of a cruel celebration. Thirsty and desperate, the prisoners drank. The elixir killed them swiftly, proving its fatal potency.

faq.q: What is inside the Tainted Keg?
aliases: what poison is in the keg
faq.answer: The keg holds Shindigger Stout, stolen from Dun Garok and mixed with the Elixir of Agony. Apothecary Lydon made the experimental poison in Tarren Mill.

faq.q: Where did the ale originally come from?
aliases: where was the stout stolen from
faq.answer: The stout came from the dwarven mountaineers and riflemen at Dun Garok, a heavily defended fortress in southeastern Hillsbrad Foothills.
Human farmers held upstairs in the Tarren Mill inn drink from the keg. The poisoned brew kills them almost at once.

faq.q: Why were the farmers being held prisoner?
aliases: why are farmers in tarren mill
faq.answer: High Executor Darthalia imprisoned the farmers because she suspected a Stormwind military strategist was hiding among them. After word came that the strategist had died elsewhere, the farmers were deemed useless and handed to the apothecaries.

angles.text: For the Royal Apothecary Society, the tainted stout marks progress toward biological weapons that can eradicate humanity.
Laced ale used to kill captured rural laborers shows the merciless tactics facing the living remnants throughout Hillsbrad.
